title: Bulk ATAC differential accessibility — ARIA V47 lane on real ENCODE replicates
purpose: Validate the V47 bulk ATAC lane (QC -> MACS3 peak calling -> peak-by-sample count matrix -> replicate-gated DESeq2 DA) end-to-end on a real, replicated bulk ATAC dataset with a known strong-signal contrast.

dataset.design: 2 conditions x 2 biological replicates (isogenic ENCODE replicates)
dataset.note: Both experiments from the same lab/pipeline -> minimal batch confound. md5-verified, coordinate-sorted.

peak_calling.mode: pooled over all input BAMs (union peak universe)

counting.note: genome order read from the BAM header via pysam; low-memory sweeping algorithm

differential_accessibility.model: replicate-level DESeq2 over peak counts (condition::replicate aggregation)

result.low_power_reason: n=2 vs n=2: DESeq2 dispersion estimation is unreliable with fewer than three replicates per group; effect sizes and FDR are noisy. ENCODE has no >=3-replicate K562 ATAC experiment.

biological_sanity.convention: positive log2FC = more accessible in GM12878 (B); negative = K562 (erythroid)

markers.note: narrow 2-peak window; negligible vs overall concordance

lane_fixes_landed: DA dispatch moved to the rna stack (pydeseq2 lives in aria-rna-env, not the chromatin env).
Peak counting uses bedtools coverage -sorted with a pysam-derived genome file (the non-sorted call OOM'd at ~111 GB RSS on an 8.7 GB BAM).
Orchestrator threads an explicit min_replicates_per_condition override (enables n=2 designs with a low_power_warning; production floor unchanged by default).
caveats: n=2 per condition -> low statistical power (honest low_power_warning); not a 3-replicate production design.
FRiP not computed (samtools absent from aria-chromatin-env) -> reported as None, never fabricated.
Single dataset, strong-signal cell-type contrast: validates correctness/direction, not sensitivity on subtle condition contrasts.
Generated during development; regenerate from a clean checkout at preprint freeze.

provenance.determinism: Replicate-gated DESeq2 DA and hypergeometric motif enrichment are deterministic; no RNG seed is used.
provenance.note: Scientific values are the measured record from `source_commit`; this provenance block was re-stamped (not recomputed) at `git_commit`. Full re-computation from the real ENCODE BAMs is separate preprint-freeze work.
